definition: The engineering discipline of designing deterministic control structures, safety guardrails, and validation cycles around non-deterministic LLM iterations.
details: Loop engineering addresses failure modes in multi-step agent executions (such as infinite execution cycles, task drift, and semantic divergence) by implementing strict termination guarantees, state schema validation, and memory pruners.
story: Picture a potter shaping clay on a spinning wheel: every nudge is tiny, but each one is guided by how the last attempt wobbled. Here is the short version: The engineering discipline of designing deterministic control structures, safety guardrails, and validation cycles around non-deterministic LLM iterations. The part that makes it sing: Loop engineering addresses failure modes in multi-step agent executions (such as infinite execution cycles, task drift, and semantic divergence) by implementing strict termination guarantees, state schema validation, and memory pruners. Each pass is a tiny course-correction — the model gets a little less wrong every time. And that is Loop Engineering — the quiet loop that turns flailing into skill.

citation.title: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
